source: STATE preprint few-shot PBMC split (Parse 10M PBMC cytokines)
notes: Finetune donors are partitioned by cytokine: STATE test cytokines are held out, STATE val cytokines are folded into finetune (few-shot train), remaining cytokines stay in finetune. All other donors are entirely train. Cytokine names follow the remapped (STATE) vocabulary, i.e. after LAP-TGF-beta1 -> TGF-beta1, Megalin -> C3a, IL-18Ra -> IL-18. Spec: https://github.com/ArcInstitute/state/blob/main/state_preprint_toml_files/parse_tomls/donor.toml
